name: ver02-g1g2-barbed-crab
description: S6 VER-02 G1/G2: Barbed Devil Impale (feature-carried grab, exclusive maintain rider, deferred exact-owner cleanup) and Giant Crab two-pincer multi-hold with per-link constrict, on the accepted C3a product (unchanged). Holds come only from real attacks with the exact grab limb; maintains, riders, releases and the deferred cleanup run from the game's own round ticks and before-tick scheduler. Launch 1 (barbed): a later successful maintain with Impale; a real failed maintain under a disclosed temporary high target CMD (natural d20 kept, restored immediately), the deferred owner cleanup, a real-claw reacquisition held through later frames, then native Dismissal through the ordinary command path (fallback: native expiry), with two fresh Barbed controls per terminal. Launch 2 (crab): two targets on the two pincers, per-link maintain/constrict, one link ended by target death while the sibling keeps its own maintain/constrict, the freed pincer reused on a replacement target, then holder-wide native expiry with both links active, with two fresh Crab controls per terminal. Launch 3 (save): one native save with an active Barbed hold (after an Impale round) and a two-link Crab, compared before/after, then one continuation round. Launch 4 (reload): a fresh process loads that save. Disclosed: holder BAB 100; target HP 100000 and escape stats -100; summon deadlines extended to 600 s (native deadline) except a terminal expiry (moved to now); appear buffs removed; brains off; units woken; navmesh placement; pauses; for Dismissal, the fact granted to the main character if absent, CL 40 / spell level 4 cast parameters and the Barbed Devil's Will base -100 (natural d20 kept).
